correctness.rationale: Expressive completeness gives exactly the union-closed team properties containing the empty team. Pointwise team complementation is an inclusion-preserving involution from these properties to intersection-closed families containing the universe, i.e. Moore families. Entailment is inclusion of denotations. The sequence and asymptotic then follow by substituting the valuation-set size 2^n into the classical Moore-family enumeration.
